web-client.rationale: Hosted web app at app.paseo.sh and a daemon-served web UI (off by default). Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo mobile, Paseo web, Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

ios.rationale: Native iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play) apps are linked from the homepage; Android APK also on GitHub releases. Minimum OS versions not checked. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo mobile, Paseo web, Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

mobile-web.rationale: The browser app explicitly supports a mobile visual viewport and compact phone layouts, connected to the same daemon agents.

cli.rationale: npm i -g @getpaseo/cli installs the CLI and daemon; TypeScript SDK @getpaseo/client. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo mobile, Paseo web, Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

claude-code.rationale: Current stable and homepage document native Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, OMP, Antigravity and Muse plus a version-pinned ACP catalog and custom providers. Provider-specific MCP and permission limits remain separate. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

Provider-specific MCP and permission limits remain separate. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

Provider-specific MCP and permission limits remain separate. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

Provider-specific MCP and permission limits remain separate. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

cursor.rationale: The current stable first-party ACP catalog explicitly names this coding-agent CLI; install and authentication are required.

gemini-cli.rationale: The current stable first-party ACP catalog explicitly names this coding-agent CLI; install and authentication are required.

grok.rationale: The current stable first-party ACP catalog explicitly names this coding-agent CLI; install and authentication are required.

antigravity.rationale: Paseo v0.15.4 registers a native Antigravity provider with the agy command, host-side availability checks and a session connection implementation. Antigravity requires agy on the host and its own sign-in. The documented adapter has Full access only and no Paseo tools or steering.

byo-subscription.rationale: Claude Code usage counts against the normal Claude plan; Codex can use ChatGPT plan access. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop.

local.rationale: The reread Why Paseo finding describes the daemon owning agents on the host with clients connecting locally. This supports local execution without borrowing a later date from another source.

own-server.rationale: Daemon on a home lab, VPS or Mac mini reached via SSH, Tailscale or relay. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop, Paseo mobile, Paseo web, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

vendor-cloud.rationale: The execution finding locates agents on user-operated machines; the hosted Hub is a trigger/control service, not vendor-operated agent compute.

worktree.rationale: Managed git worktrees per workspace with setup/teardown hooks. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo daemon and APIs. Re-attested 2026-11-07 after an independent cross-check correction to paseo:RUN-02; the cited sources were reopened and still establish this value.

container.rationale: Official Docker host deployment is documented; no per-task container provisioning or security test is implied.

review.note: The official Docker image is a deployment of the whole daemon (all workspaces and agents share one container and its mounts), not a workspace isolation option; the rationale itself says no per-task container. Needs a documented per-workspace or per-agent container option to qualify.

vm.rationale: Official Hub security guidance explicitly recommends an operator-supplied VM for stronger host containment. Paseo does not provide a VM per task.

review.note: Hub security only recommends that operators use their own OS user, container or VM for stronger containment; Paseo provides no VM isolation option, and the source is Hub while the finding scope is desktop/daemon.

parallel-runs.rationale: A workspace can run multiple agent sessions, terminals and browsers at once. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

coordinator.rationale: Agents can launch, prompt, inspect and cancel other agents of any provider; workers are retained as inspectable subagent sessions with notifications back to the parent. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Cron schedules with timezone, run-now, pause/resume/run-once. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo Hub, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

pr-workflow.rationale: PR title and body drafted from the diff; PR workspaces and PR detection; the changelog records forge support beyond GitHub (GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, Codeberg). Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo daemon and APIs.

review-ui.rationale: Changes tab shows workspace diffs. Scope: Paseo desktop.

self-hosting.rationale: Daemon via desktop, npm or Docker; Hub via npx @getpaseo/hub with embedded or PostgreSQL storage. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo Hub.

free-tier.rationale: Core app is free; Hub Free needs no card and does not expire. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo Hub.

starting-price.rationale: Core app is free; Hub Free needs no card and does not expire. Scope: Paseo desktop, Paseo Hub.

laptop-independent.rationale: The daemon owns running agents independent of any client. Scope: Paseo daemon and APIs, Paseo desktop, Paseo mobile, Paseo web, Paseo CLI and TypeScript SDK.

license.rationale: At pinned v0.15.3 commit d91ae138cb931447635e94296023414a58bedcc5, the root LICENSE applies Apache-2.0 to Paseo code and the desktop application manifest also declares Apache-2.0. Incorporated third-party components retain their own licenses; the separate relay license and hosted-service parity were not audited.

free-plan.rationale: Free app and Free Hub plan beside Pro.

per-seat.rationale: Hub Pro $15 per seat per month.

byok.rationale: Codex can use an OpenAI API key.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete first-party plan list is free self-hosting, Hosted Free, and monthly seat-priced Pro with unlimited runs; model usage and daemon compute remain user-paid separately.

subscription.rationale: The complete first-party plan list is free self-hosting, Hosted Free, and monthly seat-priced Pro with unlimited runs; model usage and daemon compute remain user-paid separately.

usage-based.rationale: The complete first-party plan list is free self-hosting, Hosted Free, and monthly seat-priced Pro with unlimited runs; model usage and daemon compute remain user-paid separately.

compute.rationale: The complete first-party plan list is free self-hosting, Hosted Free, and monthly seat-priced Pro with unlimited runs; model usage and daemon compute remain user-paid separately.

one-time.rationale: The complete first-party plan list is free self-hosting, Hosted Free, and monthly seat-priced Pro with unlimited runs; model usage and daemon compute remain user-paid separately.

issue-tracking.rationale: Bounded inspection found no accessible native issue workflow; the unused task-store library and provider task displays do not establish a shipped tracker.

multiplayer.rationale: In self-hosted Hub, separate permitted Slack human accounts in one thread share its project/conversation agent session through the explicit Same conversation setting. The Hub reuses that agent ID and delivers follow-ups; shared owner credentials alone are not the basis.

roles.rationale: Hub supplies owner, admin and member roles with enforced member/owner/resource permission differences.

sso.rationale: Bounded inspection of the public Hub authentication composition, schema and routes found email/password organization auth without enterprise SAML/OIDC SSO.
